verses.text: I cry out to the Lord ; I pray to the Lord for mercy.
I pour out my problems to him; I tell him my troubles.
When I am afraid, you, Lord , know the way out. In the path where I walk, a trap is hidden for me.
Look around me and see. No one cares about me. I have no place of safety; no one cares if I live.
Lord , I cry out to you. I say, “You are my protection. You are all I want in this life.”
Listen to my cry, because I am helpless. Save me from those who are chasing me, because they are too strong for me.
Free me from my prison, and then I will praise your name. Then good people will surround me, because you have taken care of me.
